autoexec.label: Autoexec Config
autoexec.description: Run your autoexec.cfg when the game starts.
Manage your autoexec.cfg file. Changes require game restart.
autoexec.explanation: Autoexec is a CFG file for launching a game with set convars (think console command) that will get automatically executed on launch of the game.
autoexec.usage: The mod manager uses this file to set the crosshair settings automatically without needing to run commands in the console. You can still edit the file manually if you want to add more commands.
